question: Of all the plastic ever thrown away up to 2015, what share had been recycled?
answer: About 9%. Geyer and colleagues tallied 6.3 billion tonnes of plastic waste: 9% recycled, 12% burned, 79% piling up in landfills or the environment, and only a tenth of the recycled share was recycled more than once. The full bin on the kerb shows the effort, not the destination.
move: Judge a system by where things end up, not by the effort seen.
ask: Which of my good habits do I judge by the effort I see, not by where it ends up?
trap: About 30%, the share a full recycling bin seems to suggest.
